entry.name: mc.lookup~
entry.description: lookup~ allows you to use a table of samples (buffer~ object) to do waveshaping on a signal, in which the Y values of an input signal are used as X values to look up new signal values. Input values of -1 to +1 are mapped to table values between 0 (or the specified sample offset) and the size of the table.

arguments.name: buffer-name
arguments.description: Names theobject whose sample memory is used byfor table lookup.

arguments.name: sample-offset
arguments.description: After thename, you may specify the sample offset in the sample memory of theusedfor a signal value of -1. The default offset is 0. The offset value is followed by an optional table size that defaults to 512. Note that the actualtable size is equal to the table size (set using the second argument) minus the offset (set using first argument), so raising the offset value will decrease the table size.
